title: A New Opportunity
description: Your manager calls you into the office with exciting news — a new position has opened up that could change your career trajectory. The role comes with more responsibility, a higher salary, but also higher stress.

choices.text: Ask for a week to consider it
Decline and focus on your current role

title: An Old Friend Returns
description: Someone you haven't spoken to in years reaches out. They want to reconnect and catch up. A part of you is excited, another part is cautious — you remember why you drifted apart.

choices.text: Reply warmly but keep your distance

title: An Unexpected Health Scare
description: You wake up feeling unwell and decide to visit a doctor. After some tests, the results suggest you need to make lifestyle changes. The doctor recommends medication and reduced stress.

choices.text: Take some rest and try home remedies
Ignore the symptoms and push through

title: A Financial Decision
description: You have some savings accumulated and a financial advisor suggests two options: invest in the stock market for higher returns, or put the money in a safe fixed deposit.

choices.text: Go with the safe fixed deposit

title: A Family Gathering
description: Your extended family is hosting a large gathering this weekend. Relatives you haven't seen in years will be there. It's an opportunity to reconnect — or to deal with the usual family drama.

title: A Quiet Weekend
description: You have an unexpectedly free weekend with no obligations. The city is alive with possibilities and you feel the rare gift of unstructured time stretching ahead of you.

choices.text: Rest at home and completely recharge
Explore the city and meet new people
